content: Check-in/check-out with full audit trail is the accountability core across verticals (schools, telehealth, IT): timestamped logs of checkouts, returns, movements, servicing answer 'who has what, when', reduce loss, and provide audit readiness. IT managers automate assignment around onboarding/offboarding; Cheqroom and Snipe-IT advertise 'full audit trail across every assignment and transfer'.
